description: This file implements functions related to QUIC protocol tags, including conversion, parsing, and utility functions for handling QuicTag data types.

methods.name: FindMutualQuicTag
methods.description: Finds a common QuicTag in two vectors and optionally returns its index.

methods.name: QuicTagToString
methods.description: Converts a QuicTag to its string representation, either as ASCII or hex.

methods.name: MakeQuicTag
methods.description: Creates a QuicTag from four individual bytes.

methods.name: ContainsQuicTag
methods.description: Checks if a QuicTag exists within a vector of tags.

methods.name: ParseQuicTag
methods.description: Parses a string into a QuicTag, interpreting hex or ASCII formats.

methods.name: ParseQuicTagVector
methods.description: Parses a comma-separated string into a vector of QuicTags.
